source.chapter_title: Results of the Antardasas in the Mahadasa of Mars

notes: Each antardasha is judged from the sub-period lord's dignity and house, and its position counted from the mahadasha lord. Warnings attached to lordship of the 2nd/7th (maraka), named diseases, deaths and the remedial rituals that close each section are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy.

skipped.reason: Mars-Jupiter opening verse is truncated in the scan; verses 17-19 cover the favourable case.

rules.text: Mars-Mars: with Mars in an angle, trine, the 2nd or 11th under benefic influence — a great name through official favour, abundant wealth, recovery of a lost position or property, and celebration at the birth of a child.

variants.text: Mars is strong by sign: gains of a large house, land and livestock.

rules.text: Mars-Mars: Mars in the 8th or 12th under malefic influence — health needs care, risk of injury or theft, pressure from authority and loss of money and stock.

Mars-Rahu: with Rahu dignified, under benefic influence, or in an angle, trine or the 11th — honours from authority, a house or land, marriage or the birth of a child, business success, pilgrimage and the possibility of a foreign visit.
Mars-Rahu: Rahu in the 8th or 12th or under malefic influence — risk of theft and injury, loss of livestock, health needing care, and restriction.

variants.text: Rahu in the 2nd: loss of money and much anxiety.

rules.text: Mars-Jupiter: Jupiter in an angle, trine or the 11th from Mars and well supported — more land and property, happiness and welfare at home, good health, a great name, profit in business, deep affection from spouse and children, and official honours.
Mars-Jupiter: Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars, or debilitated or combust under malefic influence — worry over authority or theft, obstacles in love, and setbacks in work and with siblings.

Mars-Saturn: Saturn dignified or in an angle or trine, joined or aspected by the ascendant lord or benefics — the goodwill of authority, a boost in reputation, stores filled, comfort from children and grandchildren, and the birth of a child.

Mars-Saturn: with Saturn debilitated or in the 8th or 12th — trouble from a foreign or hostile authority, loss of money and produce, restriction, health needing care, and loss of land in the last part.

Mars-Saturn: Saturn with malefics in the 2nd or 7th — acute anxiety, money lost while travelling, accusations and pressure from authority, theft or fire, friction with siblings and friends, lethargy, and distress to spouse and children.
Mars-Saturn: Saturn in an angle, trine or the 11th from Mars — foreign travel, damage to reputation, conduct one regrets, loss on the sale of land, change of place, defeat and a heavy heart.
Mars-Saturn: Saturn with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mars — losses through theft or authority, health needing care, and trouble from family and opponents.

Mars-Mercury: with Mercury in an angle or trine — religious discourses, prayer, charity and reflection; a very high reputation and a principled life; fine food, a vehicle, clothes and ornaments; a share of political power and success in farming.

variants.text: Mercury is in an angle or trine from Mars or in its own sign: gains of money, assets of many kinds and official honours; with a raja yoga in the chart, command, education, enjoyment and the comfort of spouse and children.

rules.text: Mars-Mercury: with Mercury debilitated, combust or in the 6th, 8th or 12th — damage to reputation, restriction, strain around siblings, spouse and children, and money slipping away; health needs care.

variants.text: Mercury is with Mars: more opponents, more fear, foreign travel and disputes with friends.
Mercury with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars: disrepute, crooked dealing and harsh talk, and losses through theft, fire or authority, especially while travelling.

rules.text: Mars-Ketu: Ketu with a benefic in an angle, trine, the 3rd or the 11th — peace and comfort through official favour, growing wealth (less at the start, more at the end), land, the birth of a child and authority in government work.
Mars-Ketu: Ketu with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars — quarrels, bickering with spouse and children, trouble from theft, and health needing care.

variants.text: Ketu in the 2nd or 7th: mental distress and loss of money and provisions.

rules.text: Mars-Venus: with Venus in an angle, trine or the 11th, or exalted or in its own sign — benefit from authority, great happiness, vehicles, clothes and ornaments.

variants.text: Venus is connected with the ascendant: comfort from the spouse, the birth of a child, luxuries and an improvement in fortune.
Venus is well placed from Mars: money, a child, the employer's goodwill, land granted or profited from, the pleasures of music and dance, and pilgrimage.
Venus is connected with the 10th lord: religious and charitable works, such as building for public benefit.

rules.text: Mars-Venus: Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars or with malefics — grief, physical discomfort, loss of money, trouble from theft or authority, conflict at home and distress through spouse and children.

Mars-Sun: with the Sun dignified or in an angle, trine or the 11th — a vehicle, high reputation, the birth of a child, wealth and provisions, welfare, good health, courage, official honours, a thriving business and a meeting with authority abroad.

variants.text: The Sun's conjunction with the 9th or 10th lord strengthens this.

rules.text: Mars-Sun: the Sun under malefic influence in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars — physical and mental strain, failure at work and deep anxiety; health needs care.

Mars-Moon: the Moon exalted or in its own sign, or in an angle with the 1st, 4th, 9th or 10th lord — fine things, charitable building, a wedding celebration, happiness from spouse and children, cooperation from parents, wealth, and ambitious tasks completed with official support.

variants.text: The Moon is waxing, so the results come more fully.
The Moon is waning, so the results are diminished.

rules.text: Mars-Moon: the Moon debilitated or in an enemy's sign in the 6th or 8th from Mars — distress to spouse and children, loss of land, livestock and produce, and danger from theft or conflict.
